requirement: Restore Clinical data from the change set written by one SaveChanges call: preview the scalar, owned-JSON, and many-to-many changes together with safety conflicts, then apply deletes, updates, and restores inside a transaction with audit capture suppressed, write a Clinical.AuditRollback entry, and refuse the rollback when current data differs from the audited after-state.

preconditions.text: A Clinical database contains audit change sets and their current rows
The change set covers many-to-many relations, formulas, and owned ranges
A stale row makes the change set unsafe to roll back

returns.text: Relations, treatments, formulas, and owned ranges are restored to the audited before-state
The rollback writes one Clinical.AuditRollback entry while intermediate audit entries stay suppressed
A stale change set is reported as a conflict instead of overwriting newer data
Development audit seed data covers every rollback scenario

exception_text: ClinicalRollbackConflictException when current data differs from the audited after-state
